race.comment: JULEP (10) followed up her brave Avoca second with a well deserved win at St Arnaud last week, breaking through for her first win by just over a length, as the favourite. She won't find this much harder, and with more upside than most here, she can take the next step immediately. KINGSFORD (1) has been battling in all 4 starts this prep, and may have needed all of those outings. He drops further in class, steps up in trip, and with the aid of the pole position, he is ready to show some decent form. Stick with him. LA REEL DEAL (3) cruised home when winning his maiden at Coleraine, and then had no favours last time out at Avoca. He is worth another chance in this. SEMPER FORTIS (4) is a winner of 6-races, and he ran his best race in some time when finishing third at Avoca 2 weeks ago. He cops a wide gate, but should be kept safe in all top 4 combos. BLACK RUTILE (7) is racing consistently this season, and he will be running on as he normally does. Top 4 claims in this.
